description: This source file defines the NoteEditorViewModel class, which manages note data, providing methods to load, save, and delete notes within an Android MVVM architecture. It interacts with a repository to perform data operations and exposes observable state for the UI.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class responsible for managing and providing note data to the UI layer, handling loading, saving, and deletion of notes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a note with the specified ID from the repository. If the ID is less than or equal to zero, considers as creating a new note and clears current note.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note, either updating an existing one or adding a new one, and executes a callback with the note ID after operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified ID and executes a callback upon completion.
